name: auto_model_cashflow_quality_derivative
hypothesis: A proprietary cashflow-efficiency derivative score may capture changes in operational quality with full coverage and lower crowding than raw fundamentals.
notes: High coverage model field; compare correlation to profitability active alpha.

name: auto_model_relative_value_derivative
hypothesis: A valuation derivative score may identify under/overpriced stocks with a different construction than raw enterprise-value ratios.
notes: Model value branch; likely lower turnover than pure price signals.

name: auto_model_earnings_certainty
hypothesis: Sustainable and certain earnings quality should be rewarded within comparable industries.
notes: Quality family but distinct field source from operating_income/equity.

name: auto_model_growth_value_blend
hypothesis: Growth potential is more valuable when not accompanied by poor relative valuation; blending ranks can reduce single-score noise.
notes: Crossover of two model scores; keep only if correlation is acceptable.

name: auto_analyst_ebitda_yield
hypothesis: Higher estimated EBITDA relative to enterprise value should proxy attractive operating yield among peers.
notes: Analyst EBITDA field has high coverage and low alpha count.

name: auto_analyst_fcf_ops_quality
hypothesis: Companies with stronger operating cash flow relative to assets may exhibit better earnings quality.
notes: Cashflow quality branch distinct from EPS yield.

name: auto_analyst_sales_eps_combo
hypothesis: Sales expectations and EPS yield together may capture top-line plus bottom-line expectation quality.
expression: 0.5 * group_rank(ts_rank(est_sales / enterprise_value, 126), industry) + 0.5 * group_rank(ts_rank(est_eps / close, 126), industry)
notes: May correlate with existing EPS alpha; correlation gate should decide.

name: auto_fundamental_debt_repayment_strength
hypothesis: Higher debt repayment relative to assets may signal balance-sheet repair and financial discipline.
notes: Low-crowding footnote field with decent coverage; monitor concentrated weight.

name: auto_fundamental_debt_issuance_pressure
hypothesis: Large debt issuance relative to assets can indicate financing pressure, so the sign is reversed.
notes: Low-crowding debt issuance branch; sparse but high enough coverage.

name: auto_deferred_tax_quality
hypothesis: Deferred tax asset/liability structure may contain accounting-quality information within industry peers.
notes: Footnote accounting branch; use lower truncation due sparsity risk.

name: auto_option_put_call_short_interest_reversal
hypothesis: Short-dated put/call volume pressure can reflect crowded fear that may mean-revert after smoothing.
notes: High coverage option field; turnover controlled with decay.

name: auto_option_skew_risk_compensation
hypothesis: Implied volatility skew may proxy downside demand and risk compensation after peer ranking.
notes: Alternative option channel; sign may be regime-dependent.

name: auto_option_breakeven_dislocation
hypothesis: Option breakeven relative to spot may contain market-implied directional information at medium horizon.
notes: Medium-dated options signal; watch correlation with momentum.

name: auto_social_sentiment_stability
hypothesis: Stable positive sentiment is more useful than noisy attention spikes, so penalize high short-term sentiment volatility.

name: auto_social_buzz_reversal
hypothesis: Abnormal social buzz often reflects crowded attention and may reverse after smoothing.
notes: Less crowded fast_d1 buzz field; likely higher turnover.

name: auto_gap_acceptance_quality_blend
hypothesis: Gap acceptance is more useful when paired with slow quality, improving correlation and turnover versus pure technical signals.
expression: 0.5 * rank((open / ts_delay(close, 1) - 1) * ((close - open) / open)) + 0.5 * rank(ts_rank(operating_income / equity, 126))
notes: QuantaAlpha-inspired gap acceptance crossed with proven quality anchor.
